statement_pretty:
∀ {R : Type} [inst_2 : NonUnitalNonAssocRing R] {a b c : R},
  Commute a c → Commute b c → Commute (-c) (a - b)

referees.justification: The 3-step synthesis across Commute resists single-lemma lookup and yields a proof-to-statement ratio of 1.31, meriting archival as a proposition. While its immediate utility outside the present formal context remains speculative, the structural coupling of hypotheses is unexpectedly persistent.

Although the statement clears the Level 1 lookup gate across Commute, the conclusion reads primarily as an accidental consequence of chaining 3 library facts. I recommend publication solely as a theorem of modest significance (6/10), noting that the kernel's indifference to mathematical taste is on full display.
